home.join.country.label: Country
home.join.where.inCountry: In {country}. To change the country, go back to the first step.
home.join.country.comingBody: You can sign up now. Your account is made and your papers are checked before the day it opens, so you can start on that day. Until then nothing moves here and nobody finds you on the map. You are told the day it opens, and who you work with there.
home.join.country.testingBody: Only invited numbers can join in {name} for now. It opens to everyone soon: leave your email to be told the day it does.
home.join.country.note: This is the company you will be paid by, so it has to be where you really are.
home.join.country.notHereBody: We have no drivers, shops or hubs there, so there is nothing yet for you to join. Countries are switched on one at a time, deliberately, by two members of SeeBuyGet staff — and this one has not been. Pick a country we do reach, or come back when we have.
home.block.countryNotActive: We do not reach that country yet. Pick one we do.
home.join.country.notActiveTitle: SeeBuyGet is not active in {name} yet
home.join.country.notActiveBody: We can match you with loads here, and you can register today. What we cannot do is handle the money: there is no SeeBuyGet company in {name}, so nobody of ours invoices, pays you, or carries any responsibility for what you are owed. You agree the price with whoever you carry for and you settle it with them directly. When a company of ours is established here, it becomes the company you work with: you will be told in your app, and asked to agree to its terms.
home.join.country.activeNote: This is the company you will be paid by, so it has to be where you really are.
home.join.interest.title: Tell us about {name}
home.join.interest.lede: We choose the next country from who is waiting in it and what they would do there. Both halves matter — the number tells us where, and the reason tells us whether it would work.
home.join.interest.messageHint: A few lines is plenty. What you move or sell, where, and what is hard about it today.
home.join.interest.thanksBody: We will write to you the day you can sign up in {name} — and if sign-ups open before the country does, again the day it opens — and say which of two things it became: a country where a SeeBuyGet company contracts and pays you, or one where we match you with loads and the money stays between you and whoever you carry for. Countries are switched on deliberately, by two members of staff, so it may be a while — and we write to you about nothing else.
home.join.country.unavailable: We could not load the countries just now — try again in a moment.
home.join.about.privacyNote: Your name and ID are kept private — they never show on the network.
home.join.about.driveNote: A bike or motorcycle starts today. Anything heavier needs a licence check first.
home.join.about.licenceNote: Kept against your record, checked by staff before you carry anything heavy. We will tell you before it runs out.
home.join.about.vehicleNote: The one you will start your first shift on — picking it also clears you to drive that class. You can add more later, or scan the sticker on any vehicle a fleet has registered.

home.market.title: What freight moves here
home.zones.title: Price zones
home.zones.lede: Each country SeeBuyGet runs in is divided into price zones. Look up the zone a place is in.
home.zones.wherePh: A town, a street or a landmark
home.zones.none: No price zone there yet: {where} is not in a country whose zones are set.
home.zones.notFound: No place found for that. Try a town and a street.
home.zones.hereFailed: Your phone did not say where you are. Type the place instead.
home.zones.failed: The zones could not be asked just now. Try again in a moment.

home.zones.send: See the price of a parcel
home.zones.notServed: We do not deliver there yet.
home.zones.noDoor: There are no deliveries to doors there: parcels are collected at its shops.
home.market.lede: Every load open on the network around a place you choose — what it needs, how far it runs, and what it is worth. No account, no sign-in.
home.market.whereLabel: Which place do you want to look at?
home.market.startLede: Type a town or city and we will show you every load open around it — what kind of truck each one needs, how far it runs, and what that work is worth.
home.market.emptyLede: No freight is posted around that place at this reach. Widen it, or try another town.
home.market.shapeCount: {n, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}} open right now
home.market.basisDetail: Every figure here is the standard rate of SeeBuyGet’s company in the country the load is picked up in, applied to that load, in that country’s money — not an offer, and not what any particular operator earns. A driver sees their own rate, on their own vehicle, when they sign in.
home.market.workGuessed: {body} · {kg} kg — worked out from the weight alone
home.market.whereUnknown: Away from any town we know
home.market.distance: {empty} km empty to reach it, {loaded} km loaded · {total} km in all
home.market.joinCta: Sign up and take this work
home.market.spoken: {n, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}} open. The most wanted truck is a {body}, with {k} of them.
home.market.spokenPlain: {n, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}} open.
home.market.spokenEmpty: Nothing is open around that place right now.
home.market.emptyRun: Trucks ran {pct}% of their kilometres empty to reach this work — {km} km in all. Empty running is a cost, so it is counted here and never inside the moved figure.
home.market.allMeasured: Every load here was measured, so the truck each one needs is known rather than estimated.
home.market.someMeasured: {pct}% of these loads were measured. The rest had their truck worked out from weight alone, which is a softer claim.
home.market.thin: too few to read as a market
home.market.seriesFoot: “Asked for” counts loads by the truck they needed; “moved” counts them by the truck that actually took them. Where the two disagree, that gap is the opportunity.
home.market.seriesEmptyLede: Nothing has been posted or moved around this place in the last year. Try a wider reach, or another town.
home.market.seriesErrTitle: We could not read the market
home.market.seriesErrLede: Something went wrong fetching the figures. Try again in a moment.
home.welcome.marketSub: Every open load around any town — what truck it needs and what it pays. No account needed.
home.welcome.verifySub: Somebody handed you one — is it genuine? No account needed.
